spring.application.name=spring-data-jpa-demo

# Relational datasource (H2 file database persists data under ./data)
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:file:./data/demo;AUTO_SERVER=TRUE
spring.datasource.driver-class-name=org.h2.Driver
spring.datasource.username=sa
spring.datasource.password=

# Hibernate / JPA
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update
spring.jpa.show-sql=true
spring.jpa.open-in-view=false

# H2 web console available at /h2-console
spring.h2.console.enabled=true

# To use PostgreSQL instead, replace the datasource properties above, e.g.:
# spring.datasource.url=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/demo
# spring.datasource.username=demo
# spring.datasource.password=secret
